text: {"lessons":["My early sales of Stocks A, D, and E were followed by buying them again at different prices; I should avoid reactive round trips and trade only when a clear plan calls for it.","Buying back into stocks does not guarantee a quick recovery, as the account later fell; I should accept that prices are uncertain and avoid judging decisions by short-term results.","Frequent account checks and several trades can encourage impulsive decisions, so I should review my positions calmly and use consistent criteria rather than reacting to every move."]}
